skills.name: Simplify rational expressions
skills.wrong_turn: Cancel factors, not terms: (x + 6)/6 is not x + 1, and (x² + 4)/(x + 2) doesn't simplify.
skills.rule: Factor top and bottom, cancel common factors, and state excluded values.

skills.name: Multiply & divide rational expressions
skills.wrong_turn: To divide, flip the second fraction, not the first: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b)·(d/c).

skills.name: Add & subtract rational expressions
skills.wrong_turn: Don't add denominators: 1/x + 1/y is (x + y)/(xy), not 2/(x + y).
skills.rule: (ab)+(cd)=(ad+bcbd); use the least common denominator in practice.

skills.name: Complex fractions
skills.wrong_turn: Excluded values include the inner denominators: x/(x − 1) above is undefined at 1, but the original is also undefined at 0 and −1.
skills.rule: Multiply the top and bottom of the big fraction by the LCD of all the little fractions.

skills.name: Rational equations
skills.wrong_turn: Multiply every term by the LCD, including whole numbers: 1/x + 2 = 5/x becomes 1 + 2x = 5, not 1 + 2 = 5.
skills.rule: Multiply both sides by the LCD, solve, and check each answer in the original.

skills.name: Extraneous solutions
skills.wrong_turn: Extraneous solutions aren't errors in arithmetic. Even perfect algebra can produce them, so always check.
skills.rule: An extraneous solution solves the transformed equation but not the original.

skills.name: Vertical asymptotes
skills.wrong_turn: A zero of the denominator isn't always an asymptote: in (x − 2)/(x² − 4) it cancels at x = 2, giving a hole.
skills.rule: f=(pq) in lowest terms has a vertical asymptote at each zero of q.

skills.name: Horizontal asymptotes
skills.wrong_turn: A horizontal asymptote doesn't forbid crossing: (2x² + x)/(x² + 1) equals 2 at x = 2.
skills.rule: Compare degrees: top smaller gives y=0; equal gives y=(anbn); top bigger gives no horizontal asymptote.

skills.name: Holes
skills.wrong_turn: The hole's y-value comes from the simplified form: (x² − 1)/(x − 1) has a hole at (1, 2), not (1, 0).
skills.rule: A factor that cancels from top and bottom leaves a hole, not an asymptote.

skills.name: Graph rational functions
skills.wrong_turn: Plot both sides of each vertical asymptote. A branch between asymptotes can cross the horizontal asymptote.
skills.rule: Find intercepts, asymptotes and holes, make a sign chart, then sketch each piece.

skills.name: Slant asymptotes
skills.wrong_turn: The slant asymptote is the quotient only: for (x² + 1)/(x − 1) it's y = x + 1, not y = x + 1 + 2.
skills.rule: If degp=degq+1, divide: (pq)=mx+b+(rq), and y=mx+b is the slant asymptote.

skills.name: Inverse variation
skills.wrong_turn: Inverse variation isn't "y = −x". As x doubles, y halves: y = k/x, not a line with negative slope.
skills.rule: y varies inversely with x when y=(kx), that is xy=k.

skills.name: Root functions
skills.wrong_turn: √(x − 2) starts at x = 2, not x = −2. Set the inside to 0.
skills.rule: y=x has domain and range [0,∞); y=x3 has domain and range all reals.

skills.name: Work & rate problems
skills.wrong_turn: Don't add the times: 3 hours and 6 hours together is not 9 hours, or 4.5. Add rates: 1/3 + 1/6.
skills.rule: Rates add: if the jobs take a and b hours alone, together (1a)+(1b)=(1t).
